hook: The fire began in Thomas Farriner's bakery on Pudding Lane.

sections.voiceover:
In four days it destroyed 13,200 houses and 87 churches.

The flames moved west on a strong east wind. Samuel Pepys buried his cheese in his garden. Here's what nobody tells you.
